verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal lists webhooks as part of its API surface, alongside OAuth client-credentials and expense endpoints, so the product claims a first-party webhook capability. That is the only mention; nothing describes how to register endpoints, which events are available, payload formats, or delivery and retry behavior. Missing for 10: webhook registration docs, event catalog, payload/signature verification details, delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow, retrieval and update endpoints across the expense surface, custom-field management, receipts, and webhooks.
